Welcome to our Loyalty Program. By downloading our mobile application or creating an account, you agree to be bound by these terms. These conditions govern your participation in the rewards ecosystem and describe the legal relationship between you and the Restaurant Group.

Membership is open to legal residents of participating regions who are 13 years of age or older. Users under 18 must obtain parental consent. Only one account per person is permitted. We reserve the right to verify your identity and eligibility at any time.
Points are earned based on qualifying purchases at participating locations. You will receive 10 points for every $1 spent. Points are credited to your account within 24 hours of a transaction.
Points expire 365 days from the date they were earned.
Points have no cash value and cannot be transferred.

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. We are not liable for any losses resulting from unauthorized access to your rewards balance due to poor password hygiene.

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your membership if we suspect fraudulent activity or violation of these terms. Upon termination, all accumulated points and rewards will be forfeited immediately.
By using the app, you accept these terms.
I agree with the terms and conditions
We collect information that you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, phone number, and birth date when you join our loyalty program.
Purchase history and favorite menu items
Our primary goal is to provide a rewarding and personalized dining experience. We use your data to:
Process orders and issue loyalty points
Send personalized rewards and birthday offers
Improve our menu based on customer preferences
Prevent fraudulent transactions and secure accounts

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who assist us in operating our app, processing payments, or delivering marketing communications, subject to strict confidentiality agreements.
You have control over your data. Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
Access and export your personal data
Request the deletion of your account

We implement industry-standard administrative, technical, and physical security measures designed to safeguard the information we collect. This includes SSL encryption, multi-factor authentication, and regular security audits of our servers.
Default entry level. Earn 1 point for every $1 spent.
Unlock at 500 points. 1.2x point multiplier on all orders.
Unlock at 2,000 points. 1.5x multiplier & priority booking.
Points remain active for 1 year from the date of the last qualifying purchase.
A reminder notification is sent 30 days before any batch of points expires.
No fees are associated with maintaining or reactivating your loyalty account.
Available for Silver tier and above.
Early access to seasonal tasting menus.

Points earned on qualifying purchases will be automatically reversed if the corresponding order is fully or partially refunded.\n\nIn cases of technical error where points were over-credited, the system reserves the right to adjust balances within 48 hours of the transaction.
Bonus points from limited-time campaigns are non-restorable once a reversal occurs.
Cancellations must be made within 5 minutes of placing the order for a full refund to the original payment method.
Once the restaurant has started preparing your food, cancellations are at the sole discretion of the branch manager.
Paid membership tiers (Gold/Platinum) are subject to a 7-day \"No-Use\" refund policy. If no benefits or discounts have been redeemed, a full refund can be requested.
